Hello! I’m Pranit Lanjewar. I am a licensed social worker, specializing in adult mental health and trauma-informed care. My professional experience includes homelessness, mental health, healthcare, community-based practice for social change, and currently in social work academia. 

I aim to pursue a Ph.D. in the near future, with a research focus on mental health and cancer. I also have many hobbies that rotate with the seasons; to mention some, biking, writing, walking, running, cooking, reading, gaming, socializing, and going on road trips.
